summary: P06 states 5 of 26 sub-steps. It gives the label-budget telescoping (L3), the deficit N-2L>0 with s<Wm (R1), the exponent inequality s/W<m^tau (R4), the one-interchange realization of each pivot of Pi (M4), and the row-sum-one disk preservation (S5). It states the bank-exchange lemma, the phase-frame proposition, the Bruhat factorization and the guard width only as results, without their mechanisms (B1-B4, P1-P4, M1-M3, S1-S4). It omits the residual table, the side-edge argument, the binary orthonormal-basis argument, the complex loss ratio and the explicit deficits eta_b and eta_c. No sub-step is stated contrary to the paper.
